_note: Reasoning for earnings-call mention markets. Two required parts: (1) the company's CALL FORMAT, and (2) per-phrase reasoning with a `kind` and a `lean` recorded BEFORE the call so mention_settle.py can score calibration.
_format_rule: CHECK THE CALL FORMAT BEFORE PRICING ANY FINANCIAL-VOCABULARY PHRASE. Learned the hard way: LYFT 'Revenue' was leaned .99 and resolved NO. Lyft publishes prepared remarks to its IR site and uses the whole call for Q&A — with no CFO walking the P&L, nobody said the word 'revenue' (0 occurrences in the transcript body; all 16 strikes matched the transcript exactly). AMD, same quarter, delivers remarks live ('a question and answer session will follow the formal presentation') and said 'revenue' ~85-90 times, hitting 16/17. On a qa_only company, financial vocabulary is UNRELIABLE and technical product names are near-worthless — only topic/entity words analysts actually ask about stay likely.

LYFT.evidence: Operator: 'Our prepared remarks are available on the IR website, and we'll use this time to answer your questions.' Transcript body: revenue 0, Waymo 6, Nashville 8, DoorDash 4. Ladder hit 10/18.

AMD.evidence: Operator: 'A question and answer session will follow the formal presentation.' revenue ~85-90 occurrences. Ladder hit 16/17.

HIMS.evidence: Moderator hands to CEO Andrew Dudum for prepared remarks after the safe-harbour statement. 'FDA' appeared ~6x on the Q1 call re: peptide reclassification.

ABNB|World Cup.why: The 2026 World Cup is co-hosted across North America and lands squarely in Airbnb's booking window. Management has been framing it as a demand catalyst; a Q2 call weeks out almost certainly references it in guidance or the host-city narrative. Topic word — survives either call format.

CELH|PepsiCo.why: PepsiCo is Celsius's distribution partner and a major shareholder. Distribution economics come up on essentially every Celsius call, and analysts ask about it directly — so it holds even on a Q&A-only format.

CELH|Vibe.why: Brand-language phrase rather than an operational one. May not surface unless a product line or campaign carries the name. Below the 0.82 bid — PASS.

LYFT|Waymo.why: Autonomy is the dominant analyst question for rideshare. Entity word driven by Q+A, which is exactly what survives Lyft's Q&A-only format. RESOLVED YES (6 mentions) — the reasoning held.

LYFT|Revenue.why: WRONG — kept as the cautionary case. Leaned .99 as a 'near-certain filler word'. That assumed a CFO walking the P&L. Lyft publishes prepared remarks separately and runs the call as pure Q&A, so 'revenue' was never said. RESOLVED NO. A financial-vocabulary phrase on a qa_only company should have been an automatic PASS.

NBIS|Nvidia.why: Nebius is a GPU-cloud operator; capacity, backlog and capex are denominated in Nvidia hardware. Analysts ask about supply directly — holds on either format.

DKNG|Alberta.why: Alberta's regulated market opening is DraftKings' live Canadian expansion story, but it is one jurisdiction among several and management may speak generically about 'new markets'. Roughly fair at the 0.86 bid — PASS.

DKNG|Expansion.why: Generic operational word DraftKings uses constantly for new-state rollout, and one analysts ask about. Far more likely than the specific jurisdiction names priced near it.

DKNG|Retention / Retain.why: Retention and hold rate are core DraftKings metrics — but this is financial vocabulary, so it depends on management delivering remarks live. FORMAT UNVERIFIED for DKNG; treat the lean as provisional until checked.

VST|Production Tax Credit / PTC.why: Vistra's nuclear economics run through the PTC floor price. Financial/policy vocabulary — FORMAT UNVERIFIED for VST; provisional.

WEN|Project Fresh.why: Named internal initiative, and companies reliably repeat their own branded program names. But branded programme names live in prepared remarks — FORMAT UNVERIFIED for WEN; provisional.

WEN|Inflation.why: Commodity and labour inflation is standard QSR margin commentary. Financial vocabulary — FORMAT UNVERIFIED for WEN; provisional.

WEN|App.why: Digital ordering is Wendy's growth narrative and a standing analyst question, so it survives either format.

HIMS|Peptide.why: Peptides are central to Hims's compounded-product and longevity roadmap. HIMS delivers remarks live, so product names are in scope. Roughly fair at the 0.81 bid — thin.

HIMS|Longevity.why: An explicitly announced Hims vertical; named strategic verticals get repeated. Format verified remarks_live, so this is in scope.

HIMS|Lab Testing.why: Underpins the personalisation and diagnostics push, but management may say 'diagnostics' or 'biomarkers' instead and the rule needs this exact phrase.

HIMS|FDA.why: Compounded GLP-1s under active FDA scrutiny; regulatory status is the top analyst question, and 'FDA' appeared ~6x on the Q1 call re: peptide reclassification. Topic word AND format verified remarks_live — survives both tests. HELD @0.85.

HIMS|Canada.why: International expansion is real but Canada specifically may lose out to 'international' or the UK/Europe assets. Below the 0.75 bid — PASS.

CAVA|Salmon.why: Grilled salmon has been Cava's headline menu-innovation item. Menu launches usually sit in prepared remarks — FORMAT UNVERIFIED for CAVA; provisional.

AAOI|Tariff.why: China manufacturing exposure makes tariffs plausible, but with only 36 open interest this is illiquid and the phrase may not surface in a quiet trade-policy quarter. Below the 0.76 bid — PASS.
